description: Data Insights by MAQ Software allows users to view data in multiple formats and quickly narrow data results. Users can switch between horizontal bar, vertical bar, brick, or tabular formats. With Data Insights by MAQ Software, users can easily explore data, select specific data, and view selected data in the format that best fits individual business needs. Business Uses: Sales – Display multiple sales key performance indicators (KPIs) simultaneously Management – Shift between multiple KPIs or reporting periods by changing the axis base Marketing – Analyze your customer base by demographic to highlight new product opportunities Key Features: Four customizable data formats: horizontal bar, vertical bar, brick chart, and table Customizable text and background colors Tooltips with additional insights Customizable color and legends Contact Us: Thank you for using Data Insights by MAQ Software!
